messages:
Nora: quick review requested on RBAC screens in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def/RBAC-Iter2. Focus areas: role matrix density, invite modal order, SSO toggle language, audit log filter discoverability. Drop microcopy and a11y nits.

Hiro: roles grid feels noisy at default width. Proposal: show condensed view with name + summary badge (counts of perms) and an expand chevron to reveal full permission matrix. Keeps surface simple for new admins.

Camila: +1. But add a discoverability hint for first-time users: a small tooltip that says "Expand to see all permissions" and is keyboard-focusable. Persist dismissal in user settings.

Nora: invite modal: current flow has role selector after emails which causes missed assignments. Reorder to role selector first, then email entry, preview, send. For bulk >500 show an async processing notice and estimated time.

Omar: SSO copy: prefer "Require SSO for sign-in" over "Enforce SSO". Add inline clarifier: "This will disable password sign-ins." Legal to confirm session revoke wording. Also include a small learn-more link.

Hiro: audit log: move time-range presets to top bar and make filter chips sticky. Encode filters in URL so links can reproduce results. On mobile collapse filters behind a single button.

Camila: a11y checklist: keyboard-only invite flow, aria-live for parsed email counts, focus management after send, contrast checks for badges and tooltips. I'll add specifics to the QA doc.

design-bot: Created ticket DESIGN-1221 for "RBAC: condensed roles view, invite reorder, SSO copy tweak, audit filters in header" assigned to @Nora.

Nora: thanks all 44d I'll update the frames and post new links by EOD. If no objections we'll hand off to eng next week.
